Hi David,

Great, the Magic Miner 40T it is.

Here is how it works. You paid $399.99 for the NerdOctaxe, and the 40T is $799.00, so the difference is $399.01. A colleague is picking that up today and will send you the invoice for it. The 40T is a pre-order and ships by December 14, 2026, and your replacement goes out once your NerdOctaxe has reached our warehouse and the difference is settled, so getting the box to UPS today or tomorrow is exactly right. Please write Shop···· on the outside of it.

One note for the room you have in mind: run it in Standard 40 TH/s mode. Turbo 50 TH/s is overclocking, it runs hotter and it would void the warranty.

Thanks again for your patience through all of this, David.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
